Subject: C-suite alignment: final MAP checkpoints & boardroom demo windows

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — this thread is to lock down the final mutual action plan (MAP) checkpoints and get the boardroom/demo windows scheduled so your execs can review the POC results before the 12/22 decision meeting. I attached the MAP_v3 with the suggested owners and dates. Highlights:

- Decision committee scoring rubric added (tab: "Scoring").
- Two demo windows proposed: 12/18 10:00–11:30 PT (short, exec-focused) and 12/20 14:00–15:30 PT (deep dive with infra & data science).
- Proposed EB attendees from our side: Jordan (AE), Marissa (CS lead), Ben (Solutions).

Can you confirm which window works better for your C-suite (CEO + Head of Data + Head of Eng) and whether Acme needs any AV or remote access specifics? I also included a short AV checklist in the attached PDF.

If both windows are possible, we can hold the 12/18 slot for the exec brief and 12/20 for the technical walkthrough, then collapse to one if you prefer.

Next steps (recommended):
1) You confirm preferred demo window(s) and any on-site AV needs.
2) We finalize MAP owners and close tasks in HubSpot (link below).
3) Marissa will run a dry run with your SRE team 48 hours before the demo.

Thanks — aiming to avoid last-minute scope creep.

—Jordan

Jordan — thanks for the clear plan. 12/18 10:00–11:30 PT is my preference for the exec brief (CEO and Head of Data can join then). The 12/20 deep dive looks good for the Eng + DS folks.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can you share the decision committee scoring rubric in a separate doc (legal wants a simple one-page criteria list we can circulate)?
- We need a short slide (1–2 slides) that summarizes the POC success metrics for the exec brief — can Marissa own that?
- AV: we'll be remote via our HQ conference room. AV checklist looks standard; Sanjay (cc'd) will confirm if the room needs extra firewall rules for screen-sharing.

Also, on procurement: procurement wants a short list of the final security questionnaires we will submit before signature (SOC2 report + data residency addendum). Please confirm timing so we can align with legal.

Best,
